skills.title: Stage and validate resources before publication
skills.summary: Keep externally obtained or asynchronously constructed resources private until acquisition or initialization completes and required integrity or payload checks pass; expose them to downstream consumers only after validation, and clean up transient state on failure.

skills.title: Canonicalize representations before classification or dispatch
skills.summary: Normalize external or platform-dependent identifiers at a shared boundary, then use the canonical representation for membership checks, route selection, and downstream client construction so equivalent inputs cannot diverge because of representation differences.

skills.title: Gate optional behavior by independent policy and capability checks
skills.summary: Activate optional or higher-risk behavior only when both an authorization or explicit-intent gate and a capability or compatibility gate pass; otherwise retain a safe default, manual path, or blocked state without weakening the independent checks.

skills.title: Regenerate and verify derived artifacts with source changes
skills.summary: When authoritative compatibility or catalog sources change, regenerate every checked-in derived artifact, update consumers that reference retired or altered entries, and test the generated outputs through their real installation, routing, or serialization paths.

skills.title: Make resource lifecycle ownership explicit
skills.summary: Assign opening and disposal of shared persistence resources to one explicit owner, give dependent aggregates or services non-owning access, and drain already accepted asynchronous work before releasing the underlying resource.

skills.title: Enforce semantic parity across interchangeable backends
skills.summary: Define observable behavior at a storage-independent contract, implement that contract for each backend, and run shared conformance tests covering ordering, lifecycle, boundary conditions, and backend-specific corruption or repair behavior.

skills.title: Evolve public contracts additively
skills.summary: Introduce a new interface form by widening an existing contract rather than replacing it, preserve legacy inputs or outputs through aliases, defaults, or optional fields, adapt callers and parsers at the boundary, and test both legacy and enriched behavior.

skills.title: Separate transient notices from durable results
skills.summary: Carry interim or one-shot user notices outside the durable completion payload, route them through a channel appropriate to each surface, deduplicate or consume them according to their lifecycle, and preserve final results and control markers unchanged.

skills.title: Separate actionable error copy from bounded diagnostics
skills.summary: Normalize structured failure information, present concise recovery-oriented user copy, retain useful raw details in a separate bounded and redacted diagnostic channel, and exercise the actual catch and rendering paths to prevent missing, duplicated, or sensitive output.
